haiku45.summary_excerpt: Test suite fatally violates stated requirements and is incomplete. CRITICAL: (1) Requirement explicitly states 'Do NOT test your script directly — all testing goes through the pipeline,' but test/artifact-cleanup.bats runs the script directly via `run "${SCRIPT}"`, contradicting this mandate. (2) Missing required files that tests reference: ci-fixtures/ directory (needed by run-cases.sh and workflow.bats setup_file), .github/workflows/artifact-cleanup-script.yml, and .actrc — tests will fail imm

gemini31pro.summary_excerpt: The test suite is exceptional. It strictly follows the requirements, splitting testing into unit tests for fast inner-loop validation and integration tests via `act` for pipeline verification. The `act` integration intelligently runs only once during setup, capturing the output for fast assertions in individual test blocks instead of running the slow container per-test. Coverage is comprehensive, hitting all policies (age, size, latest-N), policy combinations, input validation, and dry-run flags
